summary: Barnes & Noble Education, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 24, 2026, disclosing that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.08 per common share. The dividend is payable October 29, 2026 to stockholders of record as of October 14, 2026. The registrant acts as issuer; no advisor or board recommendation was disclosed, as the declaration itself constitutes the board action. This is a routine capital-return event signaling ordinary-course shareholder distributions; no deal terms, overhang, regulatory clock, or structural mechanics are implicated. Watch for future dividend sustainability given retail-education cyclicality and any covenant constraints under the credit agreement.
